affixio-tool-gate.note: Local stdio MCP server. It exposes attest_action, verify_action, and gate_tool_call. No raw tool arguments are persisted by the gate; it records a SHA-256 digest. State is stored under ~/.affix-mcp. The underlying SDK can make a licence heartbeat to api.affix-io.com; it does not send the raw tool arguments used by the gate.
